title: Wrong application of sparse categorical cross entropy loss in tutorial
author: Laubeee

comments.author: sachinprasadhs
comments.body:
Hi,

The linked tutorial is to demonstrate the API usage, but not to prove any benchmark results.

Feel free to to fine-tune the network as per your use case. Thanks!

comments.author: Laubeee
comments.body:
phew, it's been a while, and my links to the code seem no longer to point to anything useful unfortunately.

If I remember correctly, the tutorial was simply wrong in how it used the data.
IMO it is misleading for a tutorial, especially for the sake of API usage, to use incorrect dimensions resulting in a net that doesn't actually learn something useful, hence I reported this here.

However, I won't pursue this further (i.e. check if the issue still persists) as it's no longer relevant for me.
